UNDERSTAND THE OPTIONS

Crown reduction

Typical brief price band, not a quotation. Species, condition, access and permissions matter.

FROM ROOT TO CROWN

Proper care, all the way through.

Crown work

Reduction, lifting, thinning and shaping, with BS3998 principles considered.

Felling & dismantling

Sectional removal where appropriate, after a professional safety assessment.

Stump grinding

Brief depth: 200–300 mm below grade. Backfill or removal considered at survey.

Hedge cutting

Trimming and reshaping with wildlife and nesting checks before work.

Deadwooding

Selective care for dead or damaged branches; sometimes all a mature tree needs.

Tree planting

Species selection for the site, planting and formative pruning plans.

Emergency callout

Make-safe assessment first, tidy-up later. No live dispatch from this page.

Tree surveys

BS5837 planning surveys and reports for mortgage or insurance enquiries.

PROTECTED TREES DESERVE PROPER PAPERWORK

If the tree is protected,
start with the council.

In England, TPO work generally requires written consent. Conservation-area work normally requires six weeks' notice, subject to exceptions. Rules depend on the tree, location and proposed work.

The Ridgeway concept includes checking designations and handling applications or notices. No applications are actually submitted here.

Read official guidance ↗
6WEEKS

General orientation, not legal advice or permission to begin work.

NO SURPRISES IN YOUR GARDEN

What happens on the day.

  1. Access. A route for the chipper and a safe place for the truck, discussed at the visit.
  2. Protecting the garden. Ground boards and fragile items moved before work.
  3. Noise. Brief hours: weekdays 8am–5pm, Saturdays 8am–1pm. Neighbours considered.
  4. The arisings. Chips removed, left for beds or timber cut into rounds by agreement.
  5. Tidy-up. Raked and cleared as part of the planned job.

NOTHING USEFUL WASTED

Warm homes.
Happier gardens.

Sample offer: seasoned hardwood logs, £95 per cubic metre within ten miles. Woodchip free, with local delivery cost agreed. Availability and moisture content require actual verification.
